title: Your logs become the first track

steps.text: Aged drops move to the courtyard's chosen rack model without losing a unit. Slow shoots, saplings and young trees preserve their pale stump, including in view; mature renewal is counted accepted production away from finished track. Existing room tuning controls the waiting intervals. Frozen version-0 recovery verifies before the bounded supply upgrade; hash guards stay intact.
The T1 view offers accepted carry. The adapter reserves it locally while a correlated request is pending; no flight spends inventory.
The server validates reach and cadence, orders the request and durably stores its stamped tail before publishing acceptance.
Both worlds apply the same bounded transfer. The final log allocates 24 once and starts one tick-based feed/lay job. Retrying cannot spend again.
Owned views animate accepted material and build solid track. A reconnect reconstructs the verified phase quietly; the cosmetic claim is an independent atomic personal write.
